BRIGHTPATH IT SERVICES — Vendor Proposal
(SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA — for ProcureMind demonstration purposes only)

Company: BrightPath IT Services LLP
Contact: sales@brightpathit-demo.com

PROPOSAL SUMMARY
BrightPath IT Services offers a mid-range IT equipment and support package
for growing offices, focused on cost efficiency and fast turnaround.

PRICING
Total contract value: USD 97,200 for a 12-month term. Flexible monthly
payment plan available on request.

DELIVERY
Delivery timeline: 35 business days for full rollout due to current demand
on hardware supply chains.

CAPABILITIES
- Business-hours support (9 AM - 6 PM IST, Monday to Friday)
- Cloud hosting available as an add-on at extra cost
- Standard email-based ticketing for support requests
- Basic data encryption for stored files

COMPLIANCE AND CERTIFICATIONS
We are fully compliant with all applicable data protection regulations and
follow industry best practices for information security.
GST registered. MSME registered vendor.

WARRANTY
Hardware comes with standard 1-year manufacturer warranty; on-site
replacement not guaranteed and may require courier return for repairs.

NOTES
We are currently expanding our support team and anticipate improved
response times in the coming quarter.
